gameDescriptionHtml:
As a blacksmith, you find yourself trapped in a never-ending labyrinth.To escape, you will need to find a weapon powerful enough to destroy the maze.Fortunately, the labyrinth’s endlessness extends to its resources as well.Utilize all your blacksmithing skills to craft a legendary weapon and make your escape!

The labyrinth is endless. Only a weapon with great power can be the key to escaping this labyrinth.

A repetitive forging process is necessary to create a good weapon.

Hammering iron at high temperatures makes the weapon more resistant to strong impacts.

Stretching, cutting, and rejoining the iron increases the weapon’s flexibility, making it less likely to break.

Quenching the heated iron in water ensures the blade remains sharp for longer.

Fortunately, this labyrinth is rich in resources. Chop wood to make charcoal and use it as fuel for the furnace. Mining stone may yield ore that can be smelted into fine iron bars. Discovering ore with good properties allows you to smelt it into iron bars, which can then be forged into more powerful weapons.

You can’t always be working. Even in a labyrinth, you have the right to enjoy your leisure time. You can race with animals, test the performance of your crafted weapons, or even make some pretty friends in the labyrinth.
